KC Printing & Promotionals, a Portsmouth, Ohio-based print and design company, is looking for a creative and dependable Graphic Designer to join their team remotely. This is a full-time role (40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time) where you’ll be working directly with business owners and clients to bring their print and branding projects to life. Starting pay is $5 USD/hour. To apply, please submit your portfolio along with a brief video or voice introduction — we want to see your work and hear from you directly.

title: Grant Writer
description:
Parity is seeking a full-time Grant Writer Virtual Assistant to lead the company's grant writing, grant reporting, contract management, and impact measurement efforts.



Reports To: Parity Homes CEO and SOS Fund Executive Director

Works Closely With: Parity CEO, Parity Board President and Board Treasurer, SOS Fund Executive Director, third party accounting and bookkeeping firm (hereafter referred to as Key Leadership)



About The Role



As the Grant Writer, you will be responsible for overseeing grant reporting and compliance, from Parity and the SOS Fund’s variety of funding sources including philanthropic foundations, corporate foundations, private donors, government funding including federal, state, and city, and construction debt. You will also be responsible for grant writing using pre-canned templates for future funding opportunities, and for nurturing new relationships with donors. You will support the CEO and Board Treasurer in the management the operating budgets and actuals of the overall Parity Homes program, Parity Builders program, and SOS Fund program, which currently consists mostly of payroll and salaries. Finally, with the support of the CEO, you will liaise with our third-party bookkeeping and accounting firms to ensure proper on-time accounts payable, and appropriate categorization of all transactions for the relevant job (vacant property renovation), class (grant source), and account (type of expense).



Fund Development

o Conduct research on upcoming grant opportunities

o Develop and implement a comprehensive written annual resource development plan with strategies for donors and prospects

o Research and nurture donor prospects and maintain a donor prospect list

o Oversee the build out of a donor database on Salesforce and execute prompt acknowledgement of donations

o Develop and submit grant applications using pre-canned templates

o Serve as liaison between granting entity/agency and Key Leadership

o Participate in staff meetings and development activities as directed

o Performs other duties as directed by the CEO



Contracts and Compliance

o Oversee all government and foundation grants and contracts, ensure programs are in alignment with budget throughout the grant/fund period, and serve as the internal expert on grant compliance

o Work with Key Leadership to develop and implement a documented system of financial controls and accounting policies and procedures to ensure grant compliance and minimize risk

o Write and update standard operating procedures as required, to ensure compliance with government and foundation grants

o Identify potential areas of compliance risk factors and propose risk mitigation techniques

o Provide compliance update reports to Key Leadership as directed or requested



Budgets and Reporting

o Monitor expenditures against budget for the purpose of ensuring the accuracy of reported information, availability of funds, variances, and compliance with established financial guidelines and program policies, practices, and regulatory requirements

o Oversee the production of periodic financial reports on Parity programs

o Liaise with third-party bookkeeping firm to ensure proper on-time accounts payable, payroll, appropriate transaction categorization, and monthly close out

o Assist with external financial audit by preparing documents and serving as liaison for Key Leadership

o Recommend benchmarks that will be used to measure the company’s performance



Requirements

o 2-3 years grant writing experience

o Excellent English writing and speaking proficiency

o Experience with federal fund reporting compliance

o Excellent attention to detail and contract management skills to meet reporting deadlines

o Capable of professionally managing confidential information and applying discretion

o Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to understand the impact of operations on our financial results

o Strong comfortability with Excel

o Comfortability with Microsoft Word and Outlook

o Interested in or have experience working in a start-up environment

o Strategic thinker that can maneuver between high-level goals and very specific tasks to execute those goals

o Self-starter, comfortable with working autonomously, and able to hold yourself to self-appointed deliverables

title: SEO Assistant (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
About DCB Digital

We're a Brisbane, Australia-based SEO agency working with trades, professional services, and financial services businesses across Australia. Our clients are real operators with real revenue, not affiliate sites or thin content plays. We deliver measurable outcomes, work from documented systems, and don't tolerate drama or chaos.

Our three values are simple:



Own the outcome

Follow the system

Stay sharp



If those land for you, keep reading. If they don't, this isn't the role.



The role

We're hiring an SEO Assistant to support delivery across our active client accounts. You'll work directly with our Senior SEO Strategist and the two founders, contributing real, accountable work from day one.

Full-time, fully remote, AEST overlap hours required (Brisbane time, GMT+10).

You will own:



Executing on-page optimisation tasks across client accounts (meta titles, H-tags, internal linking, image alt text)

Uploading and formatting content in WordPress to DCB's quality standards

Running monthly citation and directory submissions

Supporting Google Business Profile management across client accounts

Compiling ranking data and preparing reporting inputs each month

Completing audits and checklists as directed by the Senior Strategist



Who we're looking for



Must-haves:



2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, agency or in-house, with a real portfolio of work you can speak to

Solid understanding of on-page SEO fundamentals. You know why H1s matter, what a canonical tag does, and whether a page is actually structured to answer the query it's targeting

You understand anchor text strategy, not just what it is. You know the difference between branded, exact match, and partial match anchors and why getting it wrong can hurt a campaign

Technical SEO is not a mystery to you. Broken internal links, redirect chains, crawl errors, page speed issues, you can identify them, prioritise them, and explain why they matter

Brand voice matters to you. You understand that content written in the wrong tone can damage a client's credibility even if it ranks, and you treat every piece of copy as a reflection of the client's business

You use AI tools in your workflow every day, not to replace your thinking but to move faster and produce better outputs. You know how to set up and structure AI projects properly, build out prompts and workflows, and get consistent, usable output at scale. You know when AI output needs editing and you have the judgement to fix it

WordPress experience. You're comfortable working inside the CMS without breaking things

Comfortable with Google Search Console and GA4 at a basic level

Proven ability to follow a brief and hit a deadline without being chased. You've never missed a submission without flagging it first

Strong attention to detail. You follow a brief, you work a checklist, you don't cut corners

Reliable, self-directed, and honest about what you don't know yet

You're not looking for a job to coast in. You want to be genuinely good at this, and you care about working with people who hold the same standard. You follow the industry, you test things, you read, and you're always looking for ways to get better results for clients

You have ideas and you share them. When you see something that could work better, you say so. You're not waiting to be asked

Native or near-native English, written. Australian/UK English preferred



Nice-to-haves:



Experience with Ahrefs or Semrush

Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management tools

Local SEO or GBP experience



Don't apply if:



You have less than 2 years of real, hands-on SEO experience

You're still learning what SEO is and hoping to figure it out on the job

You can't commit to consistent AEST overlap hours

You need detailed step-by-step instructions for every task

You're looking for a role where you can coast



How you think

The task list tells you what to do. It doesn't tell you why it matters or what to do when something isn't working.

We want someone who reads a client's ranking report and asks why a page dropped, not someone who waits to be told. Someone who notices an opportunity in the data and brings it up. Someone who cares whether the client is actually getting results, not just whether their tasks are ticked off.

We use AI across everything we do. We've built our own internal SEO platform around it. We're not looking for someone who dabbles. We want someone who has actually set up AI projects, built out prompts and workflows, and knows how to get consistent, usable output at scale. Someone who looks at a new client account and thinks about how to set AI up to serve that client well, not just whether to use it at all. Content that sounds generated and untouched doesn't leave our agency. Neither does AI output that wasn't configured properly in the first place.

We're not building an average agency and we're not hiring average people. The standard here is high and it stays high. If you want to work somewhere that pushes you, gives you real problems to solve, and actually invests in making you better at your craft, this is worth your time. If you're happy doing the minimum and moving on, it's not.

If you've ever gone beyond your brief because you saw something that needed fixing, we want to hear about it.

What you'll be part of

We're a growing agency and we're honest about that. We're not a 50-person operation with every process locked down. We're building something, and we want people who are excited by that, not put off by it.

That means there's real room to shape how things are done here. If you come in with ideas, we'll listen. If you spot a smarter way to run a process, bring it. If you see an opportunity we haven't acted on yet, tell us. The people who grow fastest with us are the ones who treat this like their business too, not just a job they showed up for.

We're selective about who we hire because the right person at this stage actually changes the trajectory of the agency. We're not filling a seat. We're bringing someone into the team who we want to still be here in three years, growing with us as we grow.

Compensation



AUD $900 - $1,200 per month, depending on experience

Performance bonuses tied to client retention and ranking outcomes

All software subscriptions provided

Real mentorship from senior practitioners

Clear growth path as we scale. We promote from within. The Senior Strategist role exists. If you're serious about growing, the path is real

As we grow, you grow. We review performance and compensation as the agency scales. The people who help build this will benefit from what they helped build



How to apply

Send the following to 
 with the subject line "SEO Assistant - [Your Name]":



Your CV

A
word response to: "Walk me through how you would optimise an existing page for a target keyword. What would you check and what would you change?"

A
word response to: "Tell me about a time you caught an error or quality issue before it became a problem. What did you do?"

A link to one piece of SEO work you're genuinely proud of. Could be a ranking result, a piece of content, an audit, anything. Tell us what your role was and why it mattered

A
word response to: "Tell us about a time you went beyond your task list because you spotted something that would make a real difference for a client or employer. What did you see, what did you do, and what happened?"

Your earliest possible start date



We will not respond to CV-only applications. Skip the questions and you're not shortlisted.

Selection process



Application review (within 7 days)

Loom video (3 mins) for shortlisted applicants only

Video interview with founders (30 minutes)

Short paid trial task (2-3 hours of real work)

Offer



Total timeline: 2 weeks from application to offer.



Why work with us



Two founders who take the work seriously and invest in their team. Documented systems and real SOPs. You won't be guessing what's expected. AI-leveraged workflows and a multi-agent SEO platform you'll use every day. A role where you can develop into a senior practitioner if you put the work in.



We're building a team of people who want to be the best at what they do. Not a team of task completers. If you're the kind of person who finds a way to get better every week and wants to be surrounded by people who do the same, this is the right place.

title: Estimator and Project Manager
description:
We are looking for a part time Estimator/Project Manager with minimum 2 years experience (preferably with an Australian building company) to start as soon as possible. You will help with quoting building jobs and scheduling and managing the jobs, including ordering materials. This role is to alleviate tasks from the current office manager so that she can focus on client needs, however your role could expand into this area (liaising with clients) too if you show potential.  



Hi there!  We are a small family-owned Australian based building company that has our staff and clients’ best interests at heart. We like to make sure everyone feels valued and well looked after. We undertake a lot of varied renovations such as home extensions, bathrooms and kitchens, and also have a keen interest in building new energy efficient homes.



PLEASE READ THE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY IN THE APPLICATION PROCESS.



Your purpose will be to work collaboratively with the builder and office manager to prepare building quotes for customers and to manage project schedules. The key tasks will include:

• Setting up prospective clients in Wunderbuild (the estimating/quoting & job management software)

• Managing and updating estimate/quote templates in Wunderbuild

• Utilising estimate/quote templates to quote on renovations, maintenance jobs, or new homes by undertaking the following tasks:

o Prepare material take offs

o Send out quote requests to suppliers and trades

o Review trade quotes and request revisions if all details are not as requested

o Enter the quote details into our Wunderbuild estimate/quote software

• Prepare Building Contracts from a Master Builders Template

• Using the job scheduling section of Wunderbuild to manage jobs as follows:

o to allocate timelines and manage the schedule of the job/s as they progress. It will be imperative to communicate with the builder about job progress and adjust the schedule and keep the trades updated as timelines change.

o Liaise with local trades to confirm and adjust their onsite dates as jobs progress

o Order building materials and internal fixtures and fittings and ensure they are delivered to site on time



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

• Australian building company experience (minimum 12 months)

• Experience in job estimating and job management

• Can successfully manage a schedule of work often with multiple concurrent projects and constantly changing timelines

• Able to read and understand building plans

• Able to communicate with suppliers professionally 

• Ability to compare quotes logically and ask for revisions if required

• Strong English written and verbal communication skills

• Highly organised, with strong attention to detail 

• The confidence and resilience required to work independently 

• The ability to show initiative and be a good 'problem solver' 

• Solution focused with a systematic work approach

• Confidence to collaborate with the team, complete tasks and meet deadlines 

• A solid work ethic, takes accountability, is reliable and punctual



REQUIRED SKILLS & TOOLS:

• Degree/Qualification in any of the following: Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Architecture, Construction Management, Drafting/CAD Background

• A working knowledge of Wunderbuild or Buildxact estimating and job management software

• Experience working with Tekmatix (GoHighLevel) – CRM Software

• Knowledgeable on use of core Google applications – Gmail & Drive

• Knowledgeable on use of core Microsoft applications - Excel and Word

• Able to use Zoom / Loom

• Ability to create/provide basic building floor plans for clients, such as a bathroom floor plan (not essential but would be an advantage)



OUR DESIRED APPLICANT QUALITIES MAY INCLUDE:

• Honest and open – we want you to talk to us about any challenges you face so we can help you learn and be confident within your role

• Looking for long term employment with a supportive team



If you possess the above requirements, we would love to hear from you.

title: Sales Concierge & Appointment Qualification Specialist
description:
NPA is an Australian-based company looking for an exceptional Sales Concierge & Appointment Qualification Specialist to support our growing sales team.



This is a long-term, full-time opportunity for someone who is highly professional, extremely confident on the phone, organised, and experienced in appointment setting, lead follow-up and client communication.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role. This role is best suited for someone who is confident speaking with leads, asking the right questions, qualifying opportunities, booking appointments, and ensuring no sales opportunity is missed.



You will be working with inbound and outbound leads, following up with cold or inactive prospects, booking appointments, updating the CRM, and supporting the sales process.



We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, follows up consistently, and can represent the business professionally in every interaction.



**Key Responsibilities**



*Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Setting*

• Handle inbound enquiries from potential clients

• Update CRM notes, contact records, and pipeline stages accurately

• Communicate clearly with leads by phone,
, and/or SMS

**Required Skills & Experience**



You must have experience with:

• Minimum 4-5 years experience in appointment setting, sales support, or lead qualification

 • Handling inbound and outbound calls

 • Speaking confidently and professionally with clients or prospects

 • Managing follow-ups and booking appointments

 • Updating CRM notes and pipeline stages

 • Using AI tools such as ChatGPT or similar tools



Experience with Go High Level (GHL) is highly beneficial, but not required. Training will be provided for the right candidate.



You must also:

• Have exceptional spoken English

 • Be highly confident and professional on the phone

 • Be organised and reliable

 • Be proactive with follow-ups

 • Be comfortable working with an Australian team

 • Be able to follow scripts while still sounding natural and human

 • Be comfortable using technology, CRM systems, and AI tools



If you are not confident speaking on the phone or handling sales-related conversations, this role may not be the right fit.



**Work Details**

• Full-time, 40 hours per week

 • Australian business hours

 • Paid Australian holidays 

 • Remote contractor role

 • Long-term opportunity

 • Salary: AUD $1,400 – $1,800 per month, based on experience

 • 13th month bonus



We may also offer performance incentives based on appointment quality, booking outcomes, and KPI achievement.



**Work Environment Requirements**



You must have:

• Reliable high-speed internet

 • Backup internet connection

 • Backup power supply or an alternative workspace option

 • Quiet and professional workspace

 • Working headset and clear audio setup

 • Reliable computer/laptop suitable for CRM and calling tools



**Growth Opportunity**



This role has strong long-term potential. The successful candidate may grow into a senior sales support, lead management, or sales operations role as the business expands.



We value people who are reliable, confident, organised, and take ownership of their follow-ups and results.



**How to Apply**



To be considered for this role, all applicants MUST complete our Google Form application process.



Applications submitted directly through OnlineJobs.ph without completing the Google Form will not be reviewed.



The Google Form application includes:

* Experience and skills assessment

* Communication questions

* CRM and AI proficiency questions

* Work setup questions

* Mandatory 2–4 minute video submission

* Complete a short mock client qualification/sales call

* Resume upload



Mandatory Video Submission



Your video MUST cover all 3 of the following — missing any one will result in your application not being considered:



1. Personal introduction — who you are, your background, and why you are suited to this role

2. Sales & appointment setting experience — include your experience with GHL, AI tools, and working with Australian clients

3. Mock client qualification call — a prospective client has enquired about purchasing property in Brisbane but is uncertain about timing and affordability. Demonstrate how you build rapport, ask qualification questions, and attempt to book an appointment

You’ll work closely with Founders and client teams to turn raw talking-head videos, b-roll, voice notes, event footage, and brand assets into high-performing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social platforms.

Your work will directly help founder-led brands grow visibility, attract leads, increase audience engagement, and position themselves as trusted leaders in their industries through sharp, brand-aligned, platform-native content.

- Create multiple short-form formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, educational videos, founder-brand reels, and promotional clips.

- Apply strong editing judgment around rhythm, music, transitions, pattern interrupts, zooms, framing, captions, and retention-focused pacing.

- QA all videos before submission or publication to ensure clean captions, strong audio, correct formatting, brand alignment, and high-quality exports.



Graphic Design & Carousel Content

- Design branded graphics, carousel posts, quote cards, reel covers, and promotional visuals aligned with each client’s brand guidelines.

- Turn key ideas, frameworks, quotes, and educational concepts into simple, visually strong carousel content.

- Create clean caption-overlay graphics and visual assets that support short-form video and social media campaigns.

- Maintain consistency across typography, colors, layout, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall brand style.

- Ensure every graphic or carousel feels polished, platform-native, and aligned with the founder-led brand’s voice and positioning.



Content Creation & Management

- Use AI to research trends, winning content references, viral short-form formats, competitor content, and creative angles.

- Review raw content assets to identify strong hooks, clips, 
nts, b-roll sequences, and short-form content opportunities.

- Plan and maintain a content calendar to ensure consistent, on-time publishing across social platforms.

- Organize content assets, including raw footage, b-roll, edited videos, brand photos, graphics, captions, references, and creative briefs.

- Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to generate first-draft hooks, captions, content angles, and short-form video ideas.



Social Media Engagement & Audience Management

- Monitor, respond to, and engage with comments, messages, and mentions across social platforms.

- Help maintain an active, consistent, and professional brand presence for founder-led brands.

- Support audience growth by identifying relevant online communities, ICP profiles, warm connections, and engagement - opportunities.

- Set up and manage simple ManyChat automations for new followers, CTA opt-ins, and follow-up flows.

- Track engagement patterns and audience feedback to identify what content is resonating and where improvements can be made.



Tracking & Reporting

- Generate regular reports on content performance, audience growth, engagement, and short-form video results.

- Track key metrics such as views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, comments, follows, profile visits, and leads generated.

- Identify which hooks, formats, topics, editing styles, and visuals are performing best.

- Provide clear insights and recommendations to improve future content performance.

- Use AI to make reporting, performance analysis, and repeatable content workflows faster and more efficient.



Role Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of virtual work experience in social media management, content management, or short-form video editing.

- Strong short-form video editing portfolio, especially for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn videos, and - founder-led personal brands.

- Proven ability to transform raw talking-head footage, b-roll, event clips, and long-form recordings into polished, engaging, high-performing short-form videos.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, captions, sound design, b-roll usage, visual hierarchy, storytelling, and platform-native editing styles.

- Ability to create multiple content formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, carousel posts, educational videos, and promotional clips.

- Proficient in tools such as CapCut, Descript, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop, Figma, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Opus, or similar.

- Excellent English, strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving skills, creative judgment, visual taste, and the ability to work independently with founder-led brands.



Role Results / KPIs

- 100% adherence to the content production calendar, including edited, approved, and scheduled short-form videos.

- Consistently strong QA pass rate on submitted content, with minimal captioning, formatting, audio, export, factual, or brand-alignment errors.

- Efficient production of high-quality short-form video edits from raw talking-head footage, b-roll, long-form videos, events, and other raw content assets.

- Consistent improvement in short-form video quality, including stronger hooks, sharper pacing, cleaner edits, better visual polish, and stronger brand alignment.

- <30-minute response time to social media comments, messages, and mentions during agreed working hours.

title: Creative Video Editor Needed for Live Band Promo Projects
description:
Hi there!



We’re looking for a highly creative video editor to work with us on two exciting live band promo projects.



We are McGee Entertainment, an Australian entertainment agency specialising in premium live music, weddings, private events and corporate entertainment. We have recently filmed professional live band promo content and now need someone with a strong creative eye to bring the footage to life.



This role would suit someone who loves editing music, live performance, band promo content, reels, social media ads and high-energy promotional videos.





THE PROJECTS

We currently have two projects:



Project One: Malibu Crew

Assets are ready to start now.



Project Two: Cobber

Assets will be ready in approximately 4 weeks.



Each project includes approximately 10–13 songs/videos, filmed in portrait format using two camera angles.





WHAT WE NEED

For each project, we need two main types of edits.



1. Full Song Edits (between 10-13 videos per project)

Each song needs a polished full-length video edit, cutting between the two camera angles.



These full song videos will be used on our website and promotional platforms, so they need to feel professional, engaging and performance-driven.



We are not looking for basic cuts only. We need someone who can make the edits feel dynamic, musical and visually exciting.



2. Short Reel / Meta Campaign Assets



For each project, we also need approximately 10–13 short-form video assets for Meta advertising campaigns.



These should be around 1 minute long and should splice between different songs, key band 
nts, performance highlights, hooks, stings and standout sections.



The goal is to create a strong range of assets that help future customers connect with the band.



These reels should feel:

-Creative

-High-energy

-Premium

-Engaging

-Clean and polished

-Perfect for social media advertising



The reels will also need to be duplicated/exported in the correct Instagram sizing where required.





PAY & HOURS

Pay is $20 USD per hour.



We are estimating approximately 20 hours per project, however this may vary depending on the editing process and final requirements.



Payment will be made weekly via Payoneer.





TIMLELINE

We are hoping to have Project One completed within 2 weeks of acceptance.



Project Two will begin once the assets are ready, approximately 4 weeks later.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We would love to work with someone who has:



-Strong experience editing music, live performance, promotional or social media content

-A great sense of rhythm, timing and visual flow

-Experience cutting between multiple camera angles

-Strong attention to detail

-Confidence creating high-performing reel-style assets

-A creative eye for premium, modern edits

-The ability to work independently and make strong creative choices

-Good communication and reliability



We are hoping to connect with someone we can work with on a long-term basis whenever similar projects come up.





TO APPLY

Applications without a portfolio or sample work will not be considered.



We’re excited to find the right creative editor to help us bring these live band projects to life.

title: Accountant and Bookkeeper
description:
Position Overview:

The Accountant and Bookkeeper is responsible for managing daily financial operations and ensuring compliance with Australian accounting and taxation requirements. • Handle PAYG withholding, superannuation lodgements, and income tax returns.

• Generate and present monthly and annual financial reports to management.

• Maintain compliance with relevant accounting standards and company policies.

• Collaborate with management to support budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow monitoring.

• Undertake other finance or administrative tasks as may be assigned from time to time



Qualifications:

• Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience with Xero accounting software.

• Solid understanding of Australian taxation laws and compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated experience in BAS lodgement, PAYG, superannuation, and income tax return preparation.

• Prior experience in bookkeeping and financial reporting within an Australian business context preferred.



Skills & Competencies:

• Strong proficiency in Xero and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word).

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in financial data management.

• Strong organizational and time management skills to meet deadlines.

• Effective communication skills for liaising with management, clients, and external auditors.

• Problem-solving mindset with the ability to streamline processes and improve efficiency.

title: AU Asset Finance
description:
Asset Finance Support

Remote / Work from Home |AEST Hours | Supporting Australian Asset Finance Brokers



Who We're Looking For

We're building a dedicated team of asset finance support professionals to work directly with Australian asset finance brokers. If you have hands-on experience processing equipment, vehicle, or commercial asset finance applications and understand the end-to-end broker workflow, we want to hear from you.



To Apply, please submit this form: forms.cloud.microsoft/r/4t0GcvqYPy



What You'll Be Doing Every Day



Managing asset finance files end-to-end — from initial client enquiry through to settlement and post-settlement

Data entry and file management in broker CRM platforms (Mercury, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Preparing and submitting finance applications to lenders via broker portals

Ordering and tracking asset valuations and credit assessments

Requesting and tracking pricing and rate concessions from lenders

Running asset finance calculators — balloon payments, residual values, comparison rates, repayment schedules

Preparing compliance documents, credit diary notes, settlement letters, and payout figures

Ordering and interpreting commercial credit reports (e.g. Equifax, CreditorWatch, Veda)

Coordinating with lenders, vendors, dealers, and clients throughout the approval and settlement process

Managing discharge and payout requests, PPSR checks, and ASIC searches

Preparing funds-to-complete confirmations and settlement instructions

Post-settlement tasks — invoice reconciliation, asset registration follow-up, client retention





You Must Have

2–3 years of experience in Australian asset finance — broker-side, not lender operations

Asset finance product knowledge — equipment finance, chattel mortgage, novated lease, hire purchase, commercial hire purchase, finance lease, operating lease

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Income assessment — PAYG, self-employed, company, and trust financials for asset finance purposes

CRM proficiency — Mercury, Salesforce, or comparable broker CRM

Understanding of GST, ABN, and tax implications relevant to asset finance structures

AEST business hours — full-time, Monday to Friday

Excellent written and spoken English — direct communication with brokers, clients, and lenders



Minimum Requirements



Strong understanding of chattel mortgage and finance lease structures

Comfortable handling multiple files simultaneously with strict attention to detail and deadlines

Familiar with PPSR (Personal Property Securities Register) searches and registrations

Understanding of responsible lending obligations and privacy requirements under Australian law

Proficient in Microsoft Office — Word, Excel, Outlook

Fast internet connection and professional home office setup





Nice to Have



Experience with novated leasing or fleet finance

Exposure to construction equipment, yellow goods, or specialised asset classes

Familiarity with commercial property-backed asset finance

Experience using ApplyOnline, Loanapp, or Simpology for commercial submissions

Cert IV in Finance & Mortgage Broking or equivalent





Education

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field is preferred but not required. We value hands-on Australian asset finance experience above qualifications. Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer



Competitive base salary based on experience

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months





About the Role

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: HR Operations & Systems Coordinator
description:
We are a growing international manufacturing business with operations in Vanuatu and Australia, currently focused on strengthening and centralising our HR systems, workflows, and operational processes during a period of growth and organisational transition.



Over the past 6 months, the business has implemented and begun integrating new HR systems and workforce processes, including the rollout of the Rippling HRMS platform. While significant groundwork has been completed, many workflows, processes, records, and operational systems are still being refined, centralised, and more fully utilised across the organisation.



We are looking for a highly organised and operationally minded HR support professional to help stabilise and support the day-to-day HR function while we continue improving and properly utilising the systems and workflows already in place.



This is not a purely strategic HR leadership role. We are specifically looking for someone practical, hands-on, systems-oriented, and highly organised who enjoys bringing structure to complexity, improving workflows, and helping turn fragmented processes into more consistent and scalable systems that actually work in practice.



The role will work closely with the local HR and operational teams remotely to help improve workflow coordination, workforce administration, recruitment processes, onboarding/offboarding, documentation management, compliance tracking, and practical utilisation of Rippling and related HR systems.



Key Focus Areas



* Supporting and improving utilisation of Rippling HRMS

* Centralising HR documentation, templates, and workflows

* Supporting onboarding, probation, contract renewal, transfer, and offboarding processes

* Organising workforce records, contracts, and employment documentation

* Building workflow consistency, approval pathways, and tracking systems

* Supporting recruitment coordination, applicant follow-up, and onboarding preparation

* Assisting with dashboard visibility, reminders, review cycles, and compliance tracking

* Creating practical templates, checklists, and process documentation

* Supporting HR administration and operational coordination remotely with the local team

* Helping improve visibility, structure, follow-through, and operational consistency across the HR function

* Supporting the continued development of scalable and operationally effective workforce systems



 Ideal Experience



* HR Operations / HR Administration experience

* HRMS / HRIS experience (Rippling, BambooHR, Workday, SAP, etc.)

* Strong process and systems mindset

* Excellent organisation and follow-through

* Experience supporting remote teams

* Strong English communication skills

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving operational environment

* Experience supporting manufacturing, FMCG, logistics, production, or other operational workforce environments would be highly beneficial, particularly in understanding the pace, structure, and practical realities of the workforce being supported.

* Experience supporting growing or evolving businesses where systems and processes are still being built and refined would be highly regarded



Ideal Person



We are looking for someone who is:



* Practical and operationally minded

* Highly organised and detail-oriented

* Responsive with strong follow-through

* Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity

* Confident improving systems and workflows

* Able to work independently while coordinating remotely with teams

* Calm under pressure and adaptable within evolving environments

* Comfortable balancing people support with operational realities within a growing business



Engagement Structure



We are open to:



* Full-time or part-time arrangements

* Project-based or ongoing support

* Remote engagement

* Potential future growth depending on business needs and long-term structure



The immediate priority is stabilising systems, improving workflow and operational support, helping keep the team supported and engaged, and continuing to strengthen scalable HR systems and workforce processes across the organisation.

title: Construction Accountant
description:
******TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING!******



Construction Accountant



Job Type: Full Time

Work Hours: 10:00 AM - 06:30 PM Pacific Time

Salary: $1200 per month



* Job Overview:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Construction Accountant to support our construction projects by managing documentation, ensuring subcontractor compliance, and maintaining accurate financial records. In this role, you will assist with monthly invoicing, track contract values and change orders, collect and verify compliance documents, and keep project management systems updated. You will work closely with project managers, field teams, subcontractors, and clients to ensure smooth project operations, timely communication, and accurate documentation throughout each phase of the project.



* Key Responsibilities:

Assist with monthly subcontractor invoicing, including document review and accuracy checks

Collect, verify, and track lien releases, certificates of insurance (COI), W-9s, and other compliance documents

Monitor contract values, change orders, and budget adjustments, and update internal logs accordingly

Maintain organized project documentation, digital filing systems, and project folders

Update project management platforms (Procore) and accounting systems (Sage 100 Contractor) with current project data

Coordinate document flow between office teams, field staff, subcontractors, and clients

Ensure subcontractor compliance with contractual requirements prior to payment processing

Generate project reports, cost logs, and status updates as requested by the Project Manager

Support project kickoff activities, closeout documentation, and ongoing communication across all stakeholders

Assist with scheduling, meeting coordination, and various administrative tasks related to project operations



* Qualifications:

Previous experience in construction administration, project coordination, or a similar role

Strong understanding of construction documentation, billing processes, and compliance requirements

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook)

Experience using Sage 100 Contractor and Procore project management software (required or highly preferred)

Exceptional organizational skills and strong attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple deadlines and follow up proactively

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Ability to work effectively with project managers, field teams, subcontractors, and clients

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities





Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Senior VSL Video Editor — $1,000/Month + Performance Bonuses

BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours/day

- Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM (Philippine Time)

- $1,000 USD/month, paid every two weeks via Wise

MORE ABOUT US



Young Publisher:

title: Real Estate Photo Editor
description:
**About Amerikiwi Media Co.**



Amerikiwi Media Co. is a New Zealand-based real estate photography & videography business focused on producing clean, high-quality photos for Real Estate Agents.



We use a consistent style, always using HDR Merging, window cutting, and evenly lit edits.



We are looking for a reliable photo editor to join our team.



---



**Role Overview**



You will be responsible for editing all of the real estate photos taken by the company: Merging HDR photos, colour grading, correcting lens warp, evening out lighting, ai removal of unwanted items, cutting out windows to make lighting better, making grass greener, and using photoshop to replace the sky on cloudy days.



Additionally, you will be responsible for editing drone photos: blurring out neighbouring properties, and putting boundary lines on certain photos.



You should be comfortable working with Lightroom Classic and Photoshop. It is preferable that you have your own licence for these apps, but not essential.



The focus is on delivering consistent, high-quality photos for a range of properties, new and old, big and small, rural and residential.



This is a full-time role with the potential to use spare time to use/learn other skills like video editing,  design, and social media management.



---



**Key Responsibilities**



- Edit Real Estate photos to create light and clean results

- Create clean, drone photo edits

- Perform basic re-edits on photos when feedback is received from Real Estate Agents

- Follow established processes and standards within Amerikiwi Media Co

- Communicate clearly within tasks and raise any issues early



---



**Skills & Experience**



- Strong experience editing real estate photos

- Confident with merging and editing HDR images

- Experience working with Adobe Lightroom Classic

- Strong understanding of Photoshop

- Good communication and ability to work independently



---



**Bonus Skills (Not Required, But Nice to Have)**



- Video Editing Experience on (preferably on Final Cut Pro)

- Use of Indesign for graphic design.

- Social Media Management Experience

- Administrative experience



---



**What We Offer**



- Flexible remote work. You manage your own hours

- Ongoing work with the chance for learning other skills (video editing & graphic design)

- Clear systems and expectations so you know what to do

- A supportive working environment where your work is valued

- Direct communication and feedback

- Opportunity to grow with Amerikiwi Media Co over time



---



**How to Apply**



If this sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you! Please send an
 with:



- A brief introduction about yourself

- Your CV

- Examples of some photos you've edited

- Any relevant skills or experience related to this role

- A note of your favourite Youtube Channel!

- Please start your
 with the words ‘HDR EDIT’ so I know you read this job post carefully.

 Marketing API

 experience

---

ABOUT THE PRACTICE



Valley Heart and Rhyth
dical is a new solo specialty practice in the Los Angeles area, founded and led by a cardiac electrophysiologist (heart rhythm specialist) launching after thirteen years with a large group practice. The practice opens in late summer 2026 and is being built deliberately as a small, high-quality team focused on specialty cardiac care.



This Executive Assistant role is the operational backbone of the practice. The person in this role will manage the physician's inbox, calendar, and project follow-through; document how things work; and steadily build the systems that allow a small team to run a high-quality specialty practice. This is a long-term role, and the practice is hiring for a multi-year partnership.



RESPONSIBILITIES



In the first ninety days:

• Manage the physician's inbox, calendar, and project follow-through. Take ownership of work that does not require the physician's judgment.

• Shadow the on-shore operations manager and document her workflows into clear, written standard operating procedures.

• Identify repetitive administrative tasks (claims follow-up, prior authorizations, scheduling logistics, intake coordination, document handling) that can be taken off the on-shore team's plate as the EA ramps up.

• Build a foundational documentation set — contact directories, vendor lists, payer information, credential records (handled securely).

• Establish working rhythms — standing check-ins, communication channels, project tracking.

• Help evaluate and select the operational tools (project management, secure file sharing, password management) the practice has not yet finalized.



Ongoing:

• Run the day-to-day administrative operations of the practice.

• Continuously refine SOPs as the practice learns from operating them.

• Coordinate with vendors, payers, hospital affiliations, and credentialing partners.

• Surface operational issues early, with proposed solutions where appropriate.

• Mentor and support additional offshore administrative tea
mbers as the team grows over time. The executive assistant work for the physician remains the core of this role.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



This role calls for someone who has worked inside a US medical practice before — ideally a specialty practice such as cardiology, internal medicine, electrophysiology, psychiatric, or similar — and who understands how a clinic operates on the inside: scheduling, prior authorizations, EHR workflows, payer dynamics, and patient communication.



The ideal candidate thinks in systems, writes clearly, and takes ownership without needing to be directed step by step. Documentation skill matters: SOPs, patient communications, payer letters, and vendor coordination are written work, and the quality of the writing is the quality of the work.



This is a remote role with significant autonomy. The right person makes sensible decisions independently, escalates clearly when needed, and brings forward well-framed problems with proposed solutions.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Three or more years experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Medical Administrative Assistant

• Two or more years working inside a US-based medical practice (specialty practice strongly preferred)

• Experience with at least one US EHR system (Athena, eClinicalWorks, Practice Fusion, DrChrono, Kareo, Epic, or similar)

• Working familiarity with HIPAA and secure handling of patient information

• Comfortable using project management and task management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Trello, 
, or similar)

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in everyday work

• Advanced spoken and written English

• Fluent in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar, Gmail)

• Able to overlap 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM US Pacific Time daily



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience writing standard operating procedures or operational documentation for a medical practice

• Cardiology, electrophysiology, or internal medicine practice experience specifically

• Experience supporting a solo physician or small specialty practice

• Experience during a practice launch or early-stage phase

• Experience with multiple EHR systems

• Experience with insurance credentialing or prior authorization workflows

• Clinical background (RN, medical scribe, or similar) that complements administrative experience



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

If you know how to balance the art of high-quality human writing with the efficiency of AI-assisted workflows—and you're ready for the era of AI search—we want you on our team.

Essential Skills & Qualifications



1. Core Experience (Mandatory)

3+ Years in the Trenches: Minimum of 3 years of dedicated experience successfully managing both SEO strategy and content creation.



Proven Track Record: You must be able to clearly demonstrate a history of significantly increasing website traffic and conversions. This is a core requirement; data-backed proof of your abilities is mandatory to be considered for the shortlist.



2. Content & Strategy

Generous Performance Bonuses: We heavily reward impact. Successful execution of SEO strategies and high-performing campaigns tie directly into a generous bonus scheme.



4 Weeks Paid Holidays: We value hard work, but we value rest too. Enjoy four weeks of paid time off to recharge.

Your resume and portfolio links to your written content or ranked websites.

A brief explanation of how you balance human writing with AI frameworks.

title: CREDIT REPAIR OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
CREDIT REPAIR OPERATIONS MANAGER



Full-Time · Remote · Immediate Start



$8.38/hr · $1,826/month · 8 hrs/day · Mon–Fri



Goal-Driven · Project Management · Credit repair · Team Leadership  





THE OPPORTUNITY



We're hiring one person who can own outcomes, not just tasks — someone who has run a full credit repair operation, understands the law, and can build systems that scale.



In the early stage you'll execute the work yourself. As we grow, you'll build the team around you and manage it. This role has a direct path to Head of Operations as the company scales past $50K MRR.





GOALS YOU'LL OWN



You will be measured on results. These are the targets that define success in this role:



1. Dispute letters submitted for all newly activated clients — within 5 business days of activation, every time  

2. FCRA 30-day deadline compliance across all active files — zero overdue responses, tracked weekly  

3. Client results per 90-day dispute cycle — ?3 deletions or corrections per client  

4. Monthly result reports delivered to all active clients — 100% on time, zero missed  

5. FCRA compliance rate on all dispute letters — zero non-compliant letters, QA before every send  

6. Core SOPs built and documented — dispute, onboarding, QA, and escalation by Day 30  

7. New hires certified before touching live client files — 100% trained and QA-cleared, no exceptions





PROJECT MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES



You will manage multiple active workstreams simultaneously. This is not a task-execution role — it is a results-delivery role.



- Manage 20–60 active client files as parallel projects, each with its own dispute strategy, FCRA deadline calendar, and monthly deliverable  

- Build and own the company SOP library: dispute workflow, client onboarding, escalation process, and QA checklist — from a blank page  

- Coordinate across departments on client handoffs — enrolled ? activated ? results delivered ? billed  

- Design and execute the new hire training program for Credit Restoration; define 30/60/90-day KPIs for each hire before their start date  

- Maintain the weekly KPI dashboard for Credit Restoration; present results to the CEO every Monday  

- Identify operational gaps across departments; design interim coverage and document the handoff plan for each





CREDIT RESTORATION OPERATIONS



- Pull tri-merge reports via IdentityIQ; audit all three bureaus; tag every negative item by type, dispute reason, and FCRA path  

- Draft §609, §611, and §623 dispute letters using Factual, FTC, and Metro 2 Compliance methods — no fraudulent disputes, ever  

- Submit to bureaus via certified mail or portal; own the 30-day FCRA deadline calendar for every active client  

- Escalate to §623 furnisher disputes and CFPB complaints when bureaus fail to investigate or correct properly  

- Produce monthly result reports for every active client: items disputed, deleted, updated, score change estimate, and next 30-day plan





WHAT YOU BRING



- 8–10+ years hands-on credit repair — you have personally run the full dispute workflow  

- Deep knowledge of FCRA, FDCPA, CROA, CFPB, §609, §611, §623, and 15 U.S.C. §1666B  

- Proven Metro 2 Compliance methodology experience — letter generation and the furnisher dispute process  

- Credit Repair Cloud (CRC) proficiency — pipeline, workflow automation, and client file management without training  

- Experience building SOPs and managing a dispute, processing, or customer support team  

- Familiarity with FDCPA violation filings, FCRA violation complaints, and debt defense document drafting  

- Strong written English; excellent communicator with US-based clients and bureaus  



TOOLS



Required: Credit Repair Cloud · DisputeBee · IdentityIQ · RingCentral  



Preferred: Client Dispute Manager · Dispute Fox · Prodigy · Dispute Panda · GoHighLevel · Zoho · QuickBooks  



Monitoring: IdentityIQ · Smart Credit · MyScoreIQ · Credit Karma · Annual Credit Report  





COMPENSATION



- Pay Rate: $8.38 USD/hour  

- Type: Full-Time · Remote · Permanent  

- Schedule: Monday to Friday · US business hours  

- Start: Immediate — within 2 weeks of offer  



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application with:



1. Your resume with all credit repair software and dispute methods you've used  

2. A 150–250 word written summary: your dispute workflow experience and the largest team or caseload you've managed  

3. Optional: a sample dispute letter or SOP you've written



Applications without the written summary will not be reviewed.

title: Clinical Intake Specialist – US Healthcare Revenue Cycle (Outbound, BPO Experience Preferred)
description:
ABOUT APEX FLOW REVENUE CYCLE SOLUTIONS



Apex Flow Revenue Cycle Solutions LLC is a Florida-based healthcare revenue cycle management firm. We work with medical practices across Florida to identify and recover revenue lost in their billing pipeline — specifically unpaid claims sitting in the 60–90+ day aging window. Our clients are physicians, chiropractors, and clinical practices who depend on us to recover funds their current billing system is missing.



This is a legitimate, established company with active insurance, legal agreements, and a live client pipeline. We are growing and this is a long-term role.



---



THE ROLE



We need a Clinical Intake Specialist to represent Apex Flow in outbound outreach to Florida medical practices. You will be the first voice our prospects hear.



Your clinical background is what makes this role work. You will speak peer-to-peer with practice managers and billing staff using real healthcare terminology — not a generic sales script. We provide full training, a structured opening script, and daily coaching from the Managing Owner.



This is not a virtual assistant role. This is a specialized outbound clinical outreach position. If you have medical billing or BPO experience and you speak clear, accent-neutral English — this role pays well and grows with performance.



---



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Make 65 outbound calls to Florida medical practices from a pre-vetted contact list

- Deliver a structured clinical opening script to practice managers and billing administrators

- Book 30-minute Zoom audit appointments directly into our online calendar

- Log every call with full notes — contact name, outcome, next action, date

- Skip voi
 and automated systems — only log clean human conversations

- Attend a 10-minute daily debrief call with the Managing Owner



---



WHAT WE REQUIRE



MUST HAVE — these are non-negotiable:



1. Accent-neutral English. This is the single most important requirement. Our clients are Florida medical office managers. You must be clearly and immediately understood on the first sentence of every call. We conduct a voice test during the application process.



2. Clinical or medical background. RN, LPN, medical billing specialist, medical front desk, prior authorization, or healthcare administration. This background is what allows you to speak past gatekeepers naturally.



3. Outbound phone experience. Patient scheduling, insurance verification, BPO healthcare account, or any role requiring 40+ outbound calls per day. BPO experience with a US healthcare account is strongly preferred.



4. Reliable call logging discipline. Every single call documented same day. No gaps, no catch-up logging. This is how we protect the quality of our prospect list.



5. Stable internet and professional setup. Minimum 20Mbps, quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset. We conduct a live speed test and audio check during the interview.



6. Availability Monday to Friday, 9am to 3pm Eastern Standard Time.



STRONG ADVANTAGE — not required but will increase your pay rate:



- Experience with a US medical billing BPO account

- Familiarity with terms: A/R aging, clearinghouse rejections, modifier codes, EOB, ANSI codes

- Previous experience booking appointments or warm transfers for US healthcare clients



---



COMPENSATION



Base rate: $11 to $15 USD per hour depending on experience and interview score

Weekly performance bonus: paid every Friday when daily dial target is met

Per-audit bonus: additional payment for every audit appointment booked above weekly target

Schedule: 25 to 30 hours per week to start, with opportunity to expand

This is a long-term position. We do not hire for short contracts.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Step 1: Record a 60-second voice introduction using Vocaroo (
 — free, no account needed).



In your recording, say:

(a) Your name and your medical or clinical background

(b) This sentence read naturally: "We perform zero-obligation clearinghouse checks on outstanding 60 to 90 day accounts to isolate hidden modifier rejections."



Paste your Vocaroo link in your application message. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed — no exceptions.



Step 2: In your written application message, tell us:

(a) Your medical or clinical background in 2 to 3 sentences

(b) Your outbound phone or BPO experience

(c) Your internet speed and work setup



Begin your application message with the phrase: "I understand the audit process" — this confirms you read the full posting.



We review applications within 24 hours. Shortlisted candidates move to a 15-minute screening call within 48 hours of applying.

title: Social Media Content Creator — Real Estate Brand (Build the Brand, Generate the Leads)
description:
Type of Work: Full Time



Salary: $1,000/mo base + lead bonuses (realistic $1,400+/mo, uncapped on closings)



Hours per Week: 40



Payment: Bi-weekly via Wise





WHO WE ARE



I'm Luke Smith. Former Army Ranger, 75th Regiment, 3rd Battalion. Former law enforcement. Licensed REALTOR with Real Broker LLC. I run Living in Middle Georgia — a real estate brand helping military families relocate to Robins Air Force Base in Middle Georgia.



We're a media company that happens to sell real estate. That's not a slogan. That's the business model. Content creates the audience. The audience creates the leads. The leads create the closings.



Here's where we stand right now:

• YouTube: 13,500+ subscribers, 1M+ views. Growing.

• Instagram: ~200 followers. Basically dead.

• TikTok: Minimal. No real strategy.

•
: We upload videos. That's about it.

• LinkedIn: Nothing.

• Google Business Profile: Underutilized.

• Newsletter: Goes out Wednesdays. Subscriber list isn't growing.

• DMs: Nobody is engaging with followers on any platform outside of Luke when he so happens to see a notification.



I'm about to hire a long-form editor (2-4 YouTube videos/week) and a short-form editor (10+ shorts/week). That means we'll be producing 12-15+ pieces of content every single week.



The editors handle the video. But here's the problem: content without distribution is just noise. Without someone owning the brand across every platform, building real relationships in the DMs, and turning followers into actual real estate leads — we're just posting a lot of content. That's not the same as winning.



You're the person who takes us from "we post a lot" to "we own this market."





THE GAPS YOU'LL FILL



I'm going to be specific about what's broken so you know exactly what you're walking into. This is the job.



1. INSTAGRAM IS DEAD AND IT SHOULDN'T BE.

Our YouTube has 13,500 subscribers. Our Instagram has 200 followers. Military spouses — the people who actually make the decision on where the family lives — live on Instagram. They're scrolling stories, saving carousels, and DMing accounts they trust. Right now they can't find us because we barely exist there. You build Instagram from 200 followers into a real lead source. Original posts, carousels, stories, reels — not reposts of our YouTube videos with a generic caption.



2. NOBODY IS IN THE DMS.

Every time someone follows us on any platform, nothing happens. No welcome. No conversation. No relationship. That follower could be a military family PCSing to Robins in 3 months who's nervous about finding a house, and we just let them sit there. You DM every new follower. You thank them. You ask what brought them here. You find out if they have a real estate need. You route qualified leads into Follow Up Boss (our CRM) within 12 business hours. Follower ? DM ? conversation ? CRM ? closing. That's your pipeline. I don't need you to convert the lead. I just need you to turn them into a lead.



3. WE HAVE 7 LEAD MAGNETS WITH NO DISTRIBUTION.

We're building lead magnets using the Hormozi model — give away what other agents charge for. Buyer's Guide, Seller's Guide, Investor's Guide, Relocation Guide, PCS Guide, Vendor's List, Jobs in Middle GA. These are gold. But lead magnets don't work if nobody sees them. You push them through stories, posts, DMs, link-in-bio funnels, and targeted content. You drive downloads. Downloads feed our
 list.
 list feeds FUB. That's how we grow the database.



4. OUR NEWSLETTER LIST ISN'T GROWING.

We send a newsletter every Wednesday at noon through Kit. It's a touch in our nurture system. But the subscriber list isn't growing because nobody is actively funneling social followers into
. You are the bridge. Every carousel, every story, every DM — there's always a path to the
 list. You feed the newsletter. The newsletter feeds the CRM. This newsletter is actually awesome and we have a great open rate. We just don't promote it.



5. NO LOCAL AUTHORITY CONTENT ON SOCIAL.

The editors handle video. But who's creating the "Top 10 Restaurants in Warner Robins" carousel? The "What $300K Buys You in Perry vs. Bonaire" comparison graphic? The "PCS to Robins: Your First Week Checklist" story series? The school district breakdowns, the hidden gems, the cost of living visuals? This is the content that makes military families trust us before they ever talk to us. It's the content that makes LIMG the name people think of first. You research Middle Georgia like you live here — neighborhoods, restaurants, events, base life, schools, things to do — and you turn that research into content people save, share, and send to their friends who are about to PCS.



6. TIKTOK HAS NO STRATEGY.

Shorts get cross-posted from YouTube. That's not a TikTok strategy. Military spouses aged 25-35 are heavy TikTok users. The military spouse TikTok community is massive and we're not part of it. You create TikTok-native content. You engage with the community. You become a voice in that space, not a cross-poster.



7. LINKEDIN AND GBP ARE EMPTY.

LinkedIn is where relocation specialists, base housing offices, and real estate referral partners live. GBP posts are free local SEO that directly boost our ranking when someone searches "real estate agent near me." Both are completely empty. You fill them. Consistent, platform-native content on both.



8. NO SOCIAL PROOF SYSTEM.

We close deals. We get 5-star reviews. We get video testimonials. But nobody is turning those into social content. Closing day photos, review screenshots, client story carousels, "just sold" posts with the family's story. This is the content that converts someone who's been following us for 3 months into someone who books a call. You build this into the weekly rhythm.



9. NO COMMUNITY PRESENCE.

LIMG isn't interacting with local businesses, military spouse groups, base community
 pages, local event pages, other Middle GA creators. A brand that only broadcasts isn't a brand — it's a billboard. You engage with the community. You comment. You collaborate. You make LIMG part of the conversation, not just a poster on the wall.



10. NO BRAND CONSISTENCY.

We're about to have a long-form editor, a short-form editor, me filming, a tea
 on
, and an AI building website content. That's 5 sources of content. If everybody does their own thing, the brand fragments. You own the visual identity and voice across every platform that isn't YouTube video. The colors, the fonts, the design style, the caption voice. You're the brand guardian.



11. ZERO ATTRIBUTION.

Right now if someone follows us on Instagram, sees our content for 6 months, and then calls to buy a house, we have no idea they came from Instagram. You set up UTM-tagged bio links, "how did you hear about us" tracking, and work with me to build the attribution so we know exactly which platform, which content, and which lead magnet drove the lead. If we can't track it, we can't optimize it.





WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE



When you're doing this job right, here's what happens:

• Every platform grows every month. Not vanity numbers — real followers who actually live in or are moving to Middle Georgia.

• Leads come in from social DMs every week, routed to FUB, and some of them turn into closings.

• When someone in Warner Robins, Perry, Bonaire, or Macon thinks about real estate, Living in Middle Georgia is the first name they think of. Not because of ads — because our content is everywhere and it's the best.

• Military families PCSing to Robins find our content on every platform they use — YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
 — and by the time they reach out, they already feel like they know us.

• Competitors look at the market and wonder how we're everywhere at once.

• The newsletter list grows. The lead magnets get downloaded. The database gets bigger. And Luke's phone rings.

• Then we take our best performing organic and run ads on it.



That's domination. That's the job.





WHAT YOU'LL DO WEEKLY



• Plan and execute the content calendar across Youtube, Instagram, TikTok,
, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile

• Create 5-10 original posts per week — carousels, graphics, stories, platform-native content. Designed by you, not pulled from a template library

• Write captions in our voice. Direct. Military-friendly. No corporate fluff. The way real people talk.

• DM every new follower. Run the engagement-to-lead pipeline daily.

• Push lead magnets through social and track downloads

• Route qualified leads to FUB within 12 business hours

• Create social proof content from closed deals, reviews, and testimonials

• Engage with local businesses, community pages, and military spouse groups

• Run a weekly review — what worked, what didn't, what's next and why

• Coordinate with our long-form editor, short-form editor, and me on repurposing content

• Cover 4 hours/day overlap with Eastern Time (roughly 8pm-midnight or 1am-5am Philippines time) 





WHAT I WON'T ACCEPT



• AI doing your creative work. Use it to brainstorm and speed up — fine. But if I can tell ChatGPT wrote the caption or generated the graphic, it gets redone. People can feel when something's fake. Our audience is military families making one of the biggest decisions of their lives. They deserve real.

• AI-generated images of fake families. Real photos or designed graphics. Never fake humans.

• "Real estate quote of the day" posts, motivational fluff, or hashtag spam. We're not that brand. Every post has a purpose.

• Follow-for-follow, engagement pods, or vanity metric games. I want real followers who might actually buy or sell a house.

• Being a poster instead of a builder. If you just want to schedule content and check a box, this isn't for you. I need someone who wakes up thinking about how to grow this brand.





PAY



• $1,000/mo base

• $25 per qualified lead you deliver to FUB that books a discovery call

• $100 per closing from a lead you generated through social content

• Bi-weekly via Wise. Every time.



Realistically $1,400+/mo, and the closing bonus has no cap. The better you are at turning followers into leads, the more you make. There's no ceiling. If you send us 10 leads that close, that's an extra $1,000 that month on top of everything else.





HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word BRAND in all caps. If it's not there, I delete it without reading.

2. Send me social media accounts you've personally built and created content for. Growth numbers where available. I want to see what you built from scratch — not accounts you inherited with 50K followers already.

3. One paragraph, 150 words max: You're handed a real estate Instagram with 200 followers in a military town. What do you do in the first 30 days? I don't want "post consistently and engage with followers." I want specifics. What content do you create? How do you structure DMs? What's your first lead magnet play? How do you track results?

4. Name one operator outside real estate whose social strategy you'd apply to this brand — Hormozi, Codie Sanchez, Dan Martell, or whoever you study. What specifically would you take from their playbook?

5. Confirm you can cover the 8pm-midnight Philippines time window (4 hours/day overlap with Eastern Time).



PAID TRIAL — $50, paid whether I hire you or not.



If you make it past Step 1, you'll get one week of LIMG content: 2 long-form videos, 1 market stat, 1 neighborhood photo set, plus access to our Instagram. Deliverables:

— 5 Instagram posts with captions (mix of carousels, graphics, and stories)

— A 200-word audit of our current Instagram with the 3 things you'd change first and why

— 1 sample DM sequence from first message to a new follower all the way through qualifying them as a lead

The trial is the real interview. I don't care how polished your application is. Show me what you'd actually do with the keys.



Async via Slack. No micromanagement. Hiring to win.



— Luke Smith, Real Broker LLC

title: Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator
description:
Who is Bare?

Bare is the new way to funeral. We are a holistic end of life care provider, allowing our families to grieve in their own way, at their own pace, knowing their loved one is cared for by a team who truly understand their needs.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalized and affordable. In only five years, we’ve served more than 30,000 families, have become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (with awards in customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and have built a team of more than 100 people committed to changing the way Australians deal with end-of-life. And we’re just getting started.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Travel, Procurement & Fleet Coordinator to manage operations for our Australian business. This multi-faceted role is critical to maintaining seamless daily logistics. You will be responsible for orchestrating domestic and corporate travel, managing supplier procurement in line with local compliance, and assisting with the maintenance and safety of our corporate fleet.

The ideal candidate understands the Australian vendor landscape, has experience managing corporate travel across ANZ, and brings a strong customer-service focus to supporting our local workforce.



Key Responsibilities

1. Travel Management (Approx. 40%)

Booking & Domestic Logistics: Coordinate extensive corporate travel bookings across Australia (interstate) including flights (Qantas, Virgin Australia, Jetstar), corporate accommodation, and car rentals.

Policy Compliance: Enforce the company’s travel and expense policy, ensuring cost-efficient booking habits and appropriate tier selections.



TMC & Platform Management: Act as the primary administrator for the corporate travel management platform (e.g., Corporate Traveller, FCM, or Serko) and handle corporate profile updates.



Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) & Expense Alignment: Support the Finance team by ensuring travel expenses are accurately categorized to assist with FBT reporting and tracking meals/entertainment allowances.



2. Procurement & Supplier Relations (Approx. 40%)

Local Sourcing: Raise purchase requisitions and manage the end-to-end purchase order (PO) process for Australian suppliers, covering office supplies, IT equipment, and operational materials.



Vendor Management: Onboard new vendors, track supplier performance, and maintain compliant records including valid Australian Business Numbers (ABNs) and GST status verification.



Payment Lifecycle Collaboration: Reconcile invoices against delivery receipts and POs, liaising closely with the Accounts Payable team to ensure adherence to agreed payment terms.



Modern Slavery Act Compliance: Assist the procurement team in verifying supplier compliance in alignment with corporate social responsibility guidelines and local Modern Slavery reporting frameworks.



3. Fleet Management Assistance (Approx. 20%)

Asset Tracking & Registration: Maintain an updated corporate fleet registry, ensuring all vehicle registrations (via relevant state bodies like VicRoads, Transport for NSW, TMR, etc.) and compulsory third-party (CTP) insurances are systematically renewed.



Maintenance & Safety: Coordinate scheduled logbook servicing, tyre replacements, and vehicle inspections to maintain fleet safety and uphold manufacturer warranties.



Fuel Cards & Linkt/E-Toll Management: Monitor corporate fuel card accounts (e.g., Ampol, BP, Shell) and toll account usage (e.g., Linkt), reporting on weekly or monthly variances.



I
 Management: Assist drivers with a
 reporting processes, insurance claims documentation, and coordinating roadside assistance when required.



Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in an operations, procurement, or corporate travel coordination role within Australia. Previous exposure to vehicle fleet coordination or logistics is highly regarded.



Technical Systems: Proficiency with ERP/financial software (e.g., Xero, MYOB, SAP, NetSuite), expense management tools, and corporate travel software (e.g., Velocity, Concur).



Regulatory Understanding: Familiarity with Australian business operational requirements, including GST invoicing principles, state-based vehicle registration rules, and basic workplace safety requirements.



Communication & Negotiation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to handling internal staff requests and local vendor negotiations.



Problem-Solving: Strong situational awareness with the ability to resolve rapid shifts in logistics, such as travel disruptions or freight delays.



What We Offer

Competitive salary package.

Collaborative team environment with hybrid working flexibility.

Clear pathways for professional growth and career progression across the operations and procurement functions.



Please include a link to your resume for review.
