title: Vacant Land Real Estate Closer
description:
Summary

Vacant Land Real Estate Closer



Inbound + Outbound  |  Multi-State Pipeline  | $10-12/hr with experience and track record PLUS Performance-Based Bonuses

Job Type Long-term contract, 20 hrs to grow to 40 hrs/week (independent contractor)

Compensation Hourly depending on experience + performance bonuses per closed deal (uncapped)

Start Date Within 2 weeks of selection

Schedule Core hours US Eastern Time (M–F, 9a–5p ET)

Markets 22 active states across the Southeast, Midwest, Mid-Atlantic, and Mountain West

Reports To Owner / Operator (direct, no middle layer)



About Golden Terrain Ventures

Golden Terrain Ventures (GTV) is a raw and vacant land acquisition and retail resale business operating in 22 states. We acquire under-market parcels directly from motivated sellers, add value through diligence (title cleanup, soil/perc, access verification, market positioning), and resell to recreational, residential, and rural buyers.



Need to be familiar with Real Estate market - Land background a plus plus knowledge of Business applications and AI, Claude, Google Gemini. 



The Role

We need a veteran closer who lives inside a CRM, treats every lead like a P&L line, and can run a clean script without sounding like one. You will own the lead-to-close pipeline: warm inbound seller calls, structured outbound to qualified lists, follow-up cadences, offer negotiation, contract execution, and buyer-side conversion when called on.

You are not a setter. You are not an SDR. You are a closer who also knows how to set, qualify, and nurture because you have done all three for years. You will be the human voice on a heavily systematized pipeline owning the conversations the automation hands you and the ones you generate yourself.



What You Will Own

• Inbound seller call intake from SMS, voi
 drops, mailer responses, and website forms

• Outbound dials and SMS sequences against pre-vetted, county-validated lead lists

• Qualification using GTV's buy box criteria and a standardized discovery framework

• Offer presentation, objection handling, and price negotiation within authorized ranges

• Contract execution coordination (purchase agreements, addendums, title handoffs)

• Buyer-side closing for resale parcels when inventory comes to market

• CRM hygiene: every lead status, disposition, next action, and note current within 24 hours

• Daily and weekly pipeline reporting against KPI dashboard



Required Experience (Non-Negotiable)

• Verifiable real estate closing experience — you have closed deals, plural, and can show the receipts. Land experience is a strong plus but not required if your closing track record is real.

• Documented closed-deal volume — be ready to show a 12-month deal count, average deal size, and close rate against contacted leads.

• Power user of at least one real estate CRM — GHL, REISift, Investorfuse, Podio, Pebble, REI Reply, or equivalent. Tell us which one and for how long.

• SMS marketing fluency — you understand 10DLC, A2P registration, opt-out compliance, deliverability, and how to write SMS that gets a reply without getting a number blacklisted.

• Scripted call experience with the ability to improvise — you can run a structured discovery, but you know when to throw the script away.

• Comfort with virtual close workflows — e-sign, mobile notary coordination, remote earnest money, title company handoffs across multiple states.

• Clear, professional spoken English. Neutral or light regional accent acceptable.

• Reliable internet, a quiet call environment, and a USB headset (not earbuds).



Strongly Preferred

• Experience selling parcels under 25 acres in rural Southeast / Mid-Atlantic / Midwest markets

• Hands-on experience with GHL (GoHighLevel) as a CRM and Smarter Contact for SMS/dialer

• Familiarity with Land Insights, Land ID, PRYCD, or comparable comp/valuation tools

• Working knowledge of title issues common to vacant land (vesting deed discrepancies, easements, access, mineral rights)

• Buyer-side experience: building a buyer list, qualifying retail land buyers, owner-finance closings

• Comfort working inside a documented SOP library rather than freelancing your own process



KPIs You Will Be Measured On

These are the numbers reviewed weekly and tied to performance bonuses. Misses two months in a row trigger a written improvement plan; three months trigger separation.



Activity KPIs (Weekly)

Metric Target How Measured

Outbound dials per day 80 minimum Smarter Contact dialer logs

Live seller conversations / week 25 minimum GHL dispositions: 'Live Conversation' or higher

SMS replies handled / week 100% within 4 business hours Smarter Contact response timestamps

Inbound seller call answer rate ? 85% GHL / phone system reports

CRM data hygiene 100% Every touched lead has updated status, disposition, notes, and next-action date within 24 hrs



Pipeline KPIs (Monthly)

Metric Target How Measured

Qualified leads generated 40+ /month GHL stage: 'Qualified' (meets buy box)

Offers sent 20+ /month Signed offer documents in GHL

Offer-to-contract conversion ? 25% Executed PSAs / offers sent

Contract-to-close conversion ? 80% Closed deals / executed PSAs

Closed acquisition deals 3+ /month by Day 90 Funded and recorded



Performance Bonuses

Compensation is intentionally weighted toward performance. Strong closers earn well above their hourly base. Bonuses are paid the Friday after a deal funds — no waiting on quarterly resets.

• Per-Deal Bonus (Acquisition): Tiered structure that scales with monthly closed-deal count. The more you close in a month, the higher the per-deal payout — and tier bumps apply retroactively to every deal closed that month.

• Per-Deal Bonus (Resale): Flat bonus on cash sales, plus trailing payments on owner-finance sales for on-time buyer performance, plus stacking bonuses on multi-parcel packages.

• Margin Bonus: Additional bonus per deal when your closed acquisitions average at or below 60% of Top Market (per GTV formula).

• KPI Streak Bonus: Lump-sum bonus for hitting every weekly activity KPI for 12 consecutive weeks.

• Big Deal Bonus: Bonus tied to net profit on any closed deal exceeding a defined profit threshold.

• Quarterly Performance Bonus: Additional performance bonus paid quarterly based on overall pipeline contribution and KPI consistency.

Specific bonus amounts and structure are detailed in the offer letter at hire.



Tech Stack You Will Use

• CRM: GoHighLevel (GHL)

• Dialer & SMS: Smarter Contact

• Valuation & Comps: Land Insights, Land ID

• Document Execution: GHL (e-sign and contract management)

• Knowledge Base: Claude AI (SOPs, scripts, objection library, deal analysis)

• Data Layer: Google Apps for Business (Drive, Sheets, Docs)

• Communication: Slack, GHL, and Smarter Contact



How to Apply

We read every proposal. Generic copy-paste applications go straight to the bottom of the stack. To be considered, your proposal must include the following — in this order:



1. The Header

Start your proposal with the word LAND on the first line. This confirms you read the post. Applications without it are auto-rejected.

2. Your Track Record

• Years closing real estate deals (specify land vs. residential vs. commercial)

• Closed deal count in the last 12 months

• Average deal size (acquisition price, resale price, or both)

• States or regions you have closed in

• Lead-to-close conversion rate (your honest number — we will verify the math)

3. Your Stack

• CRMs you have used as a daily driver and for how long

• SMS platforms you have run, with rough monthly send volume

• Dialer experience (manual, power, parallel)

4. A Live Sample

Pick ONE of the following and include it directly in your proposal:

• A 60–90 second voice memo of you walking through an opening seller call (no real PII)

• Your written discovery script for a cold inbound vacant land seller

• A short write-up of the toughest objection you have closed against and exactly how you handled it

5. Two Questions, Answered Briefly

• Q1: A seller verbally accepts your offer on Tuesday. By Friday, they are not returning calls or texts. What is your exact next-72-hours plan?

• Q2: You discover at title that the deed vesting does not match the seller as listed. The seller wants to close in two weeks. How do you keep the deal alive without overstepping the title company?



What Working Here Looks Like

You will not be micromanaged. You will be measured. The pipeline, the data, the scripts, and the systems are already built — your job is to close. If you are the kind of closer who gets restless when leads sit in a queue and who feels physically uncomfortable when a CRM stage is out of date, you will fit in here. If you need someone behind you holding a stopwatch, this is the wrong seat.

Long-term, the right person becomes the lead voice of GTV acquisitions and resale and earns into a senior tier with profit-sharing on originated deals. The ceiling here is what you make it.

title: Dispatch Operations Specialist
description:
AJG Transport (GH Logistics Affiliate) is a US based asset carrier operating 150+ company trucks on dedicated government contract freight. We run 365 days a year on consistent, contracted routes across 48 states. We're scaling fast with new markets, new lanes, new teams, and we need operators who can keep up.



This isn't a BPO. This isn't a call center. You'll be embedded in a real U.S. logistics operation working alongside American dispatchers, drivers, and carriers on live freight.



Role Overview

You're an operator working directly alongside our dispatch and freight management team, handling the higher complexity operational work that keeps our network running. Think of this as the role that handles what most people can't, the exceptions, the escalations, the details that make or break a load.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Book and coordinate loads across our network while ensuring proper carrier coverage, profitability, and operational efficiency. You own the load from booking through final delivery.

• Monitor and manage active loads across our network. Tracking, status updates, carrier and driver communication, and exception handling. You own the load from pickup to delivery.

• Verify data accuracy, documentation completeness, and process compliance across active loads. Catch problems before they become expensive.

• Conduct check calls, appointment scheduling, detention tracking, rate confirmations. You're the voice on the phone making sure freight moves on time.

• Respond to driver inquiries, route them to the right internal team, document issues. Drivers call with problems and you solve them or escalate them fast.

• Ensure accurate data on TMS for Loads, rates, stops, and documents. Everything in our systems needs to be accurate. You're the last line of defense before bad data creates bad decisions.

• Identify recurring issues, flag inefficiencies, and recommend fixes. We don't want someone who just follows a checklist. We want someone who makes the checklist better.

• Report daily and weekly ops summaries for US leadership.

• Know what you can solve vs. what needs to go up the chain, and route it fast. No sitting on problems.



Who We’re Looking For

• 2+ years experience in freight brokerage, dispatch, or logistics operations. NOT GENERAL VA WORK. We need someone who already knows what a BOL is, what detention means, and how a load moves from quote to delivery.

• Hands on experience with TMS platforms such as McLeod, Aljex, Turvo, or similar. If you've dispatched loads in a real system, we want to talk to you.

• Familiarity with load boards such as DAT, Truckstop, Highway or similar. You've sourced carriers or managed freight on these platforms before.

• Strong written and verbal English. You'll be on calls and email with US based drivers, carriers, and leadership daily. This is non negotiable.

title: Video Editor — Short-Form Content (B2B SaaS for the Home Services Industry)
description:
We're hiring a video editor who lives and breathes short-form content. We're a fast-growing B2B SaaS company serving home services businesses, and we use home-services content to build our audience and bring in customers. You'll be turning existing long-form videos, raw footage, and your own ideas into scroll-stopping TikToks and Reels that grow that audience. 



The founder films rarely, so about 90% of the job is repurposing existing video or building your own concepts and scripts from scratch — you need to be someone who can run with an idea and work with minimal supervision.



[What you'll do]:

Cut creative short-form videos (TikTok, Instagram Reels) from repurposed long-form content and your own original scripts.

Write captions, hooks, and on-screen text that pull viewers in. 

Keep every post on-brand and jump on trends while they're still climbing.



[You must be strong in]:

Visual storytelling — you know how to frame a narrative, build tension or interest across a short clip, and hook an audience in the first two seconds. 

Copywriting — you write scripts that complement the visuals instead of just describing them, you understand platform-specific voice (TikTok is conversational, LinkedIn is more measured), and you know basic SEO for hashtags and keywords. Use of AI to help you write is okay. NOT AI GENERATED VIDEOS.

Self-direction — since the founder can't film most of the time, you'll spend ~90% of your time repurposing existing videos or writing and executing your own scripts, working with minimal supervision. You won't be completely on your own, though — you'll be working alongside a partner who's been with the company for years and will help and support you along the way.

Brand consistency — you maintain a recognizable visual identity across posts: consistent color palettes, fonts, and tone. 

Trend awareness — you can spot a trend early (preferably American trends), adapt it to our niche, and execute before it peaks.



[Requirements]:

At least 2–3 years of experience editing short-form content. 

Able to produce at least 5–10 shorts per day. 

A laptop or computer that can handle 4K video editing smoothly, plus plenty of storage. 

Must be available to work 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday. 

Must be able to work with minimal supervision.

Must be okay to do one unpaid trial video (you can put watermark on it).



[Nice to have (a plus)]:

Long-form editing experience (preferably talking head videos). 

Experience working with AI tools like Claude to build scripts or captions, NOT AI GENERATED VIDEOS.



[The role]:

Short-form is the priority right now. If we love your work, there's room to take on long-form too (mostly talking head videos).



[To apply, please send]:

a) 3 of your best short-form videos, preferably at least 1 repurposed video

b) your best long-form video (if any)

Despite the long job ad requirements, this is a very chill job! And again, you won't be completely on your own. You'll be working alongside a Filipino partner who's been with the company for years and will help and support you along the way. Very excited to hear from you!

title: Mortgage Support (Associate/Specialist/Sr. Associate) from (CA/US/UK/PH/AU etc) – Australian Market
description:
Location: Fully Remote - Work From Home

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary: Competitive, commensurate with experience and role placement



About Our Company



Your Virtual Partner (YVP) is a premier outsourcing and smart staffing solutions company specializing in connecting global talent with high-performing businesses across Australia. We operate as a seamless, virtual extension of our clients' teams, allowing them to scale their operations effortlessly, maximize productivity, and focus on growth.



While we provide tailored outsourcing across various corporate sectors, our core expertise lies in the financial services space. The vast majority of our clients are top-tier professionals within the Australian Mortgage Broking Industry—including residential brokerages, commercial finance firms, and non-bank lenders. Due to rapid expansion and an increasing demand for premium administrative and processing support from our AU broker clients, we are looking for dedicated financial professionals to join our high-performing global workforce.



About the Opportunities



To make our application process seamless, we have consolidated our current hiring needs into a single open application portal. We are actively building out our deal teams and have three (3) distinct career streams available, depending on your professional experience, lending specialization (Residential vs. Commercial), and technical skill set.

Review the profiles below to identify which stream matches your background, and indicate your preferred option when submitting your application.



[CAREER 1] MORTGAGE SUPPORT ASSOCIATE (Residential Focus – Entry to Mid-Level)



Role Overview: The Mortgage Support Associate plays an essential role in helping individuals and families secure residential financing for their homes. Your primary responsibility is to serve as an operational anchor, guiding clients through the intricacies of the home loan application and origination process. You will evaluate client financial goals, match them with suitable loan products, gather critical documentation, and manage files through to underwriter approval while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Customer Consultation & Guidance: Meet with potential borrowers to explore financial goals, assess mortgage needs, and provide clear guidance on suitable home loan products, interest structures, and lending terms.

- Application & Loan Processing: Assist borrowers with completing comprehensive mortgage applications and meticulously collect all required supporting documents (including income statements, credit reports, and property appraisals).

- Pre-Qualification Assessment: Evaluate borrower financial profiles to determine eligibility across various residential programs and issue formal pre-qualification letters to assist clients in their property search.

- Product Selection & Loan Structuring: Stay continuously updated on diverse mortgage loan products, shifting interest rates, and individual lender guidelines to structure loans that perfectly balance client goals with lending criteria.

- Credit Counseling & Advice: Help clients interpret credit reports, identify viable strategies to improve credit scores, and advise them on how their unique credit history influences their borrowing options.

- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain proactive, regular contact with borrowers, keeping them informed of file status, missing documents, or processing milestone updates.

- Relationship Management: Cultivate and support robust professional relationships with real estate agents, property appraisers, title companies, and lender underwriters.

- Compliance & Ethics: Execute all origination and filing activities in strict compliance with federal and state laws, maintaining the highest ethical standards under the Best Interest Duty (BID).



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Prior experience in banking, mortgage administration, or customer financial services.

- General knowledge of residential lending products, interest rate lock-in procedures, and credit files.

- Exceptional communication and customer service skills, with a passion for helping clients navigate complex financial journeys.

- Strong ethical grounding and attention to compliance detail.



[CAREER 2] MORTGAGE SUPPORT SPECIALIST (Commercial & Non-Conventional Lending)



Role Overview: We are seeking a highly specialized, detail-oriented Mortgage Support Specialist with direct experience in the Australian commercial real estate, private lending, and development finance sectors. In this role, you will serve as the technical and operational backbone of our commercial deal team. You will support brokers through highly complex non-conventional funding structures, ensuring applications meet stringent institutional and private standards and moving high-value files smoothly from initial intake to settlement.



Key Responsibilities:

- End-to-End Commercial Deal Support: Manage processing and administrative requirements for a diverse portfolio of Australian commercial, private, and specialized development finance files.

- Application Packaging: Prepare and assemble highly comprehensive, professional loan application packages for submission to a panel of Australian private lenders, non-bank lenders, and specialist development finance institutions.

- Advanced Document Validation: Meticulously collect, review, and analyze complex commercial and corporate document packages, including:

- Financial Data: Australian Business Number (ABN) records, corporate tax returns, Notices of Assessment (NOA), and Business Activity Statements (BAS).

- Property Records: Valuations from registered Australian valuers, formal Title Searches, and local council planning permits.

- Project Files: Detailed development appraisals, construction costings, sales/revenue forecasts, and full project feasibilities.

- Pre-Assessment & Underwriting Support: Assist in the initial underwriting phase, assessing deal viability against specific, strict Australian lender criteria before submission.

- Professional B2B Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for sophisticated clients and institutional introducers (mortgage brokers, financial planners, commercial accountants), providing technical updates on deal progress.

- Network Coordination: Manage communication and document flows between Australian-based valuers, commercial solicitors, conveyancers, and accounting professionals.

- Rigorous Compliance & Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF) and Know Your Client (KYC) checks in absolute alignment with AUSTRAC regulations and Australian Credit Licence (ACL) obligations. Ensure all commercial files comply with the National Consumer Credit Protection (NCCP) Act where applicable.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Direct, proven experience supporting brokers or lenders within the Australian commercial real estate or development finance market.

- Deep proficiency in reading and validating corporate financials (ABN, BAS, NOA) and understanding commercial project metrics (feasibility models, construction drawdowns).

- Comprehensive familiarity with AUSTRAC compliance, KYC workflows, and non-bank lending standards.

- Exceptional analytical capacity and sharp attention to detail.



[CAREER 3] MORTGAGE SUPPORT – SR. ASSOCIATE (Residential Expertise & Team Leadership)



Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced and leadership-minded Mortgage Support - Sr. Associate with extensive expertise in the Australian residential mortgage industry. This role requires an advanced understanding of loan structuring, credit policy, and client relationship management. Beyond managing high-tier and complex files, you will demonstrate leadership qualities by driving process optimization, staying on top of tech-stack integrations, and mentoring junior tea
mbers to ensure the overall operational team maintains premium quality output.



Key Responsibilities:

- Advanced Pre-Qualification: Conduct initial high-net-worth client consultations to map out homeownership strategies; evaluate complex serviceability and creditworthiness using tools like Quickli and applying the 5 Cs of Lending.

- Complex Loan Structuring: Educate clients on advanced loan combinations and recommend optimal solutions tailored to multi-property portfolios, expertly balancing fixed vs. variable splits and flexible repayment terms.

- CRM & Pipeline Management: Guide clients smoothly through applications while managing files end-to-end utilizing advanced mortgage CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Creatio, and Salestrekker.

- Secure Document Workflows: Oversee the secure and rapid execution of digital documentation utilizing platforms such as DocuSign and Ezidox, ensuring zero data-integrity errors.

- Credit Analysis & Compliance Auditing: Deeply analyze credit bureau reports, formulate credit improvement roadmaps for clients, and ensure absolute adherence to Australian mortgage regulations, including Loan Estimates and Closing Disclosures.

- Post-Closing & Settlement Excellence: Coordinate final document compilation to guarantee frictionless loan settlements; support clients post-settlement with direct debit structures, offset account setups, and ongoing client care.

- Business Development & Networking: Proactively build and nurture long-term relationships with core referral networks (real estate agencies, accounting firms, wealth managers) leveraging LinkedIn, industry forums, and freelancer platforms.

- Tea
ntorship & System Optimization: Act as an escalation point and mentor for junior support staff; spearhead internal process improvements to accelerate client onboarding and minimize application turnaround times.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Significant, hands-on experience in the Australian residential mortgage industry managing end-to-end file flows.

- Mastery of Australian mortgage software and CRMs (specifically Salestrekker, Quickli, Salesforce, or Creatio).

- Experience mentoring tea
mbers, reviewing loan files for quality assurance, or leading process improvements.

- Masterful communication, negotiation, and problem-resolution abilities.



Common Requirements Across All Paths:

- Fluency in professional written and spoken English, with exceptional communication skills suitable for interacting with Australian brokers, lenders, and clients.

- High organizational capability with a demonstrated ability to multitask under tight financing deadlines.

- Adaptability to work hours aligned with Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

- High-speed internet access and a dedicated, professional workspace (for remote positions).



--

What We Offer:

- Market-leading salary packages built around your specific role placement.

- Leave Credits with Carryover & Cash Conversion

- YVP Engagement Activities

- Performance-based bonuses and milestone rewards (depending on client)

- Complete training and onboarding on premium mortgage platforms.

- Clear internal pathways for promotion and professional development.

- Collaborative, energetic, and highly supportive team culture.

title: Viral Video Editor
description:
We Need an Editor Who Thinks Like This Video

Watch this before you apply.





That's 30 seconds. One hook. Seven camera angles. A full story. And you couldn't stop watching.

That's the job.



What we do

We produce short-form video ads for brands across Southeast Asia. Parents are the audience. 

 and Instagram are the platforms. Three seconds is all you get before they scroll.

Your job is to make them stay for all 30.



You're the right editor if:

You open every project thinking about the hook first, not the music. You know how to hide the face, the product, or the punchline for the first two seconds just to create curiosity. You use motion blur and angle cuts as storytelling tools, not a
 edits. You can build a micro-narrative (setup, reveal, payoff) inside 30 seconds without it feeling rushed. You sync cuts to beats instinctively. You've shot or edited content that hit over 100K views and you know exactly why it worked.



What you'll be doing

Editing 15 to 
 second video ads for
, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts. Taking raw interview footage, B-roll, and testimonials from schools and turning them into content that earns attention. Building hook sequences deliberately (the first 3 seconds are the only metric that matters on first delivery). Working async with a marketing lead who gives you clear briefs, clear feedback, and fast turnaround expectations. Producing 2 to 5 cuts per week depending on campaign load.



Technical:

Premiere Pro or CapCut Pro. Comfortable with text overlays, burnt-in subtitles, speed ramps, and motion blur effects. Basic colour grading for vertical video. 9:16 format is your primary canvas. 60fps source footage handling is a bonus.



Hard pass if:

You need a week to turn around a 30-second cut. You don't know what a hook is or you think it's just a flashy intro. You've never edited to a beat. You treat the first frame as a title card.



How to apply

Two things only. Send a link to one short-form video you edited (under 60 seconds). Then write one sentence: what was your hook strategy for the first 3 seconds? No CV. No portfolio deck. Just the work and the thinking behind it.
